add_point.title: Page 1 skips the first page
add_point.body: Pages start at 1 (see the comment above), but the start is page * size, so page 1 begins at item `size`. Use (page - 1) * size.

add_point.title: averageTotal([]) is NaN
add_point.body: With no orders the sum is 0 and totals.length is 0, so this divides 0 by 0. Return 0 when there are no totals.

add_point.title: describeOrder throws for an id that does not exist
add_point.body: orders.find returns undefined for an unknown id, so order.id throws a TypeError. Say the order was not found instead.

review.finish: Three bugs in orders.js: the page offset, the empty average and the missing order.
